MTR01AshForgePOI04Ext03 |refid ={{ID|00264e00}} |keywords = * {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionMTR}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScaleSmall}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeWorkingClass}} }} The '''Hornwright air purifier site #04''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in the [[Ash Heap]] region of [[Appalachia]]. ==Background== Located due north of the town of [[Beckley]], this site is one of four locations where [[Hornwright Industrial]] set up their [[air purifier]]s. This was the site chosen to display the new technology to the public.[[:File:F76 Air Purifiers.png|Air Purifiers advertisement poster]] In reality, the air purifiers were not used to clean the air but instead were modified to serve as a tool to convert aerosolized minerals back into a solid form. Supposedly, there is tinned crab meat in the area.''[[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia]]'' p. 376, HORNWRIGHT AIR CLEANSER SITE #04:
''"If you're hankering for some tinned crab meat, visit this cleanser site."'' ==Layout== This site contains a single building up the hill which contains a locked level 1 [[explosives crate]], a [[Combat shotgun (Fallout 76)|combat shotgun]], and assorted junk. [[Scavenger (Wastelanders)|Scavengers]] may be poking through the filing cabinets. A [[Janelle's camp|small campsite]] has been set up to the north of the site where [[Janelle Priblo|Janelle]] and [[Raymond Priblo]] were preparing to hunt the fabled [[The Beast of Beckley|Beast of Beckley]]. ==Appearances== The Hornwright air purifier site #04 appears {{In|FO76}}. ==Gallery== F76 Purifier Site 04.png|Night time at the site FO76 State Route 83 sign.png|Roadway to the east F76 Air Purifiers.png|Air Purifiers advertisement poster ==See also== * [[Hornwright air purifier site 01|Hornwright air purifier site #01]] * [[Hornwright air purifier site 02|Hornwright air purifier site #02]] * [[Hornwright air purifier site 03|Hornwright air purifier site #03]] ==References== {{References}} '''Non-game''' {{Navbox locations FO76}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Hornwright air purifier site #04}} [[Category:Hornwright Industrial locations]] [[Category:Fallout 76 locations]] [[Category:Ash Heap locations]] [[ru:Очиститель воздуха Хорнрайт — точка 4]] [[uk:Майданчик «Хорнрайт» для очищувача повітря №4]] [[zh:宏恩萊特空氣淨化器設置地點04]]

Marsh cottage.content:
{{Infobox location |games =FO76 |type =unmarked |image =FO76 Marsh cottage 01.png |map marker =(nearest: [[The General's Steakhouse]]) |map marker image =The General's Steakhouse map.png |local map = |part of =[[Cranberry Bog]], [[Appalachia]] |creatures = |robots = |quests = |cell name = |refid = }} The '''marsh cottage'''''[[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide]]'' p. 486: ''"'''Cranberry Bog (Zone A) - Secondary Locations'''''
8. Marsh Cottage (northeast of General's Steakhouse): ''A trailer has been wrenched in half by creeping root tendrils. Loot the place, as well as the phosphate deposite outside the dwelling."''
([[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia]]) is an [[Fallout 76 locations|unmarked location]] in the [[Cranberry Bog]] region of [[Appalachia]]. It is situated northeast of [[the General's Steakhouse]]. ==Layout== This broken trailer has two halves, one of which is sinking into the ground, as [[Strangler plant|strangler vines]] surround the domicile. Despite this, the trailer's interior is in decent condition, and the front door still works. There is a truck parked outside of the location, with a [[Toolbox (Fallout 76)|toolbox]] in its bed. The more stable half of the trailer has a bathroom and kitchen area with several [[Fallout 76 junk items|junk items]] to loot. The broken half has an unusable bed, a lootable [[Dresser (Fallout 76)|dresser]], as well as a nightstand and sofa. The most notable thing in the area, however, is the [[Resource deposits|phosphate deposit]] behind the trailer, yielding [[raw fertilizer]]. ==Appearances== The marsh cottage appears only in ''[[Fallout 76]]''. ==Gallery== FO76 Marsh cottage 02.png|From behind, plus phosphate deposit FO76 Marsh cottage 03.png|Stable half FO76 Marsh cottage 04.png|Broken half ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 unmarked locations]] [[Category:Cranberry Bog locations]]

SundewGrove01Ext02-04 |refid ={{ID|0026069c}} |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionCranberryBog}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeOutdoors}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScaleSmall}} |edid =SubCranberrySundewGrove01Location }} The '''overgrown sundew grove''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in the [[Cranberry Bog]] region of [[Appalachia]]. ==Background== One of several mutated groves of [[sundew]] plants that have graduated from insects to human-sized vertebrates to supplement their diet. This particular one has swallowed and grew through two houses that were erected in a picturesque location. ==Layout== Like other groves in the Cranberry Bog, the overgrown sundew grove consists of large, mutated drosera plants that spray toxic chemicals. Because of its proximity to [[fissure site Prime]], the [[Scorched]] from there can often attack the wildlife residing in the grove. This particular grove has a higher number of sundew plants, which have grown through two buildings. The first building is a small house to the east with a [[Safe (Fallout 76)|safe]] and [[Refrigerator (Fallout 76)|refrigerator]] inside. The other is a shed to the west with a [[Duffle bag (Fallout 76)|duffle bag]] and [[Wooden crate (Fallout 76)|wooden crate]]. Fresh [[cranberries]] can be harvested throughout the grove. ==Notable loot== * Potential [[Fallout 76 recipes|recipe]] - In the western shed. ==Appearances== The overgrown sundew grove appears only {{In|FO76}}. ==Gallery== F76 Overgrown Sundew Grove.png|In the sunlight FO76 Crandew nif.png {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 locations]] [[Category:Cranberry Bog locations]] [[ru:Разросшаяся роща росянок]] [[uk:Розрослий гай з росичкою]] [[zh:蔓生的毛氈苔叢]]
